name: Amelia Waters
source:
A successful writer who lives in a shabby apartment with her cat. While in front of her laptop, she paints beautiful pictures of love and romance of all spectrums. What halts her from being the absolute best are her sex scenes, which are robotic and redundant. With a sense of determination and a 4-year-old dry spell, she is determined to make her sex scenes better somehow!

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/love-and-romance-a-study-of-intimacy]itch.io[/url]]
